name: Flame Crest
summary: Flame Crest watches the volcanic wastes from a rocky ledge in the Burning Steppes. The neutral camp shelters scouts, beast collectors, and strategists, while wind riders carry travelers across the Redridge range and beyond.

sections.title: A Precarious Perch
sections.body: Flame Crest clings to a stone ledge above the ash and lava plains. You cross a narrow wooden bridge to reach the camp. Its height helps keep prowling beasts and roaming orc warbands at bay. Wind riders carry travelers across the Redridge range to Kargath, Stonard, Thorium Point, and Rog'mar in the Riverglades.

sections.title: Shadow of Blackrock
sections.body: Scouts at Flame Crest watch the Blackrock clan entrenched in Blackrock Spire. They gather intelligence and plan how to break the renegade Dark Horde. The camp also trades with eccentric loners, including Kibler, a pet master who lives in a nearby cave.

faq.answer: Flame Crest is a neutral camp in the Burning Steppes. A crude bridge leads to its narrow rocky perch, where travelers find flight routes, shelter for scouts, and supplies in a deadly region.

faq.q: Where does the flight master at Flame Crest fly?
faq.answer: Wind riders from Flame Crest fly to Kargath in the Badlands, Stonard in the Swamp of Sorrows, Thorium Point in the Searing Gorge, and Rog'mar in the Riverglades.

faq.q: Why is the Horde maintaining an outpost in the Burning Steppes?
aliases: why is horde in burning steppes
faq.answer: The Horde maintains no fortress at Flame Crest. The camp is neutral, though its wind riders carry Horde travelers. From the perch, scouts watch the Blackrock clan in Blackrock Mountain. The Dark Horde defies Warchief Thrall and threatens the region, making a local vantage point matter.

faq.q: Who lives in the cave at Flame Crest?
aliases: who is in flame crest cave
faq.answer: Kibler and his loquacious parrot, Opus, live in the cave at the back of the outcropping. Kibler is an eccentric handler interested in rare and dangerous wildlife from the surrounding wastes and Blackrock Spire.

faq.q: What is Eitrigg doing at Flame Crest?
aliases: why is eitrigg at flame crest
faq.answer: Eitrigg is not stationed at Flame Crest. The veteran orc serves at Warchief Thrall's side in Orgrimmar. The neutral waystation shelters traders, scouts, and wind riders who watch the Blackrock clan.

angles.text: Flame Crest gives Horde travelers a wind rider connection and shelter in a neutral camp in the northern Burning Steppes.
As an orc loyal to Thrall, you can watch the rogue Blackrock clan from this camp. Its presence stains the mountain.
